description: As a reviewer, act on a plan PR: approve, request_changes, comment (optionally on lines), reply (in a thread) or suggest (a structured change the author accepts in one click: suggestion_id or model). approve and request_changes post as the human GitHub account on this machine: ONLY use them when the user explicitly said so in this conversation, and pass the exact version they saw.

line.description: First plan line to anchor a comment

model.description: Propose running the plan on this model

text.description: Comment, reply, or verdict note (required for request_changes)
